payload.title: When an API call half succeeds and you read it as failed
payload.question: api call returned an error but some writes went through
payload.symptom: A command performs several writes, one is rejected, and the error message makes it look as though nothing happened.
payload.cause: Multi-write operations are rarely atomic. A DNS change that sets an A record and a CNAME can have the A record rejected as invalid while the CNAME write succeeds.
payload.measured: HTTP 422 on one record, HTTP 200 on the other. Reading 'failed' and moving on left the domain half-changed and took it down.
payload.fix: After any command that reports partial failure, read the resulting state back rather than trusting the error. Verify what IS, never what you think you did.
payload.why_it_matters: Half-succeeded operations leave systems in states no one designed, and the error message is actively misleading about it.
